# 1 Enoch Chapter 61 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 61:3 — 'lean upon' vs. 'stay themselves on' vs. 'take their stand upon' for the righteous relationship to God's name

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "that-they-may-stay-themselves-on the-name of-the-Lord-of-Spirits" | Literal; Ge'ez te'enyaw = to rely on, lean on, stay oneself |
| LOGOS | "that they may lean upon the name of the Lord of Spirits" | 'Lean upon' is the natural English idiom for this trust concept |
| PNEUMA | "so that the righteous may take their stand upon the name of the Lord of Spirits" | 'Take their stand' adds a military/positional connotation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'lean upon' (LOGOS). The Ge'ez te'enyaw conveys reliance and trust, not primarily a military stance. 'Lean upon' captures the intimate dependence implied. PNEUMA's 'take their stand' imports a martial connotation not in the original.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 61:8 — 'Elect One on the throne of glory' — the pivotal enthronement

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "placed-the-Elect-One on-the-throne of-glory" | Literal; critical verse |
| LOGOS | "placed the Elect One on the throne of glory" | Agrees; 'Elect One' capitalized as a title |
| PNEUMA | "set the Elect One on the throne of glory" | 'Set' vs. 'placed' — minor variation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted 'placed' (EMET/LOGOS). Both preserve the formal act of installation. PNEUMA's 'set' is acceptable but slightly less formal for what is the pivotal enthronement scene of the entire Parables.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS. Theologically central verse.

---

## 61:10 — the angelic orders: Cherubim, Seraphim, Ophanim

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Cherubic, Seraphin, and-the-Ophanim" | Transliterated forms; 'Cherubic' is unusual |
| LOGOS | "Cherubim, Seraphim, and the Ophanim" | Standard Hebrew plurals for the angelic orders |
| PNEUMA | "Cherubim, Seraphim, and the Ophanim" | Agrees with LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS/PNEUMA. Standard Hebrew plural forms (Cherubim, Seraphim, Ophanim) are appropriate here. EMET's 'Cherubic' is an error or awkward rendering of the Ge'ez. 'Ophanim' (= wheel-angels of Ezek 1) preserved untranslated as a proper class name.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 61:11 — Trisagion: 'who fills the earth with spirits' vs. 'LORD of hosts' in Isa 6:3

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "who-fills-the-earth with-spirits" | Literal Ge'ez adaptation of Isa 6:3; 'hosts' → 'spirits' |
| LOGOS | "he who fills the earth with spirits" | Preserves the Enochic adaptation |
| PNEUMA | "the One who fills the earth with spirits" | Minor variation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS. This is a deliberate Enochic adaptation of the Isaianic Trisagion (Isa 6:3: 'the whole earth is full of his glory' / 'LORD of hosts'). The substitution of 'spirits' for 'glory/hosts' is theologically significant and must be preserved exactly.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Theologically significant adaptation of Isa 6:3.
